metric_contracts.consumed_reference_tracking: Euclidean Cartesian position norm and SO(3) principal angle at exact consumed pre-step QP ticks; original 0..26.98s, no resampling/interpolation
metric_contracts.native: Saved independent fresh kinematics at all 13501 original 2ms states, 0..27s inclusive; statistics use all states
metric_contracts.native_csv: Every tenth original fresh state plus terminal: 1351 exact 20ms samples with original fresh_state_index; full precision .17g; not a new simulation
metric_contracts.consumed_csv: All 1350 actually consumed QP-input reference ticks with matching fresh_state_index; original time/position; .17g
metric_contracts.control_csv: Every tenth applied 2ms torque interval (ends .020..27.0s), original interval start/end preserved; all-native torque statistics; .17g
metric_contracts.old_missing_QP_vectors: Six original reused slots have original scalar intervention only; nominal/selected vector norms omitted and NOT_MEASURED_OLD_EVIDENCE; no vector inference
metric_contracts.existing_PCC_interval_diagnostics: Saved existing PCC/capsule clearances and current/ramp envelope margins, each retains original pair/envelope scope; nonfinite unavailable CSV cells are empty, no zero imputation
metric_contracts.Task_base_path: Original independent minimum-jerk Task position polynomial evaluated at saved times; no residual reference reconstructed; deviation is not Task failure
metric_contracts.rigid_Task: Target-frame Task grasp transformed by fresh target pose, displayed only in terminal Task window [25.5,27]s
metric_contracts.Task_gate: Original independent evaluator requirement results copied verbatim; no curve-wide tolerance or gate inferred
metric_contracts.base_drift: Fresh base translation norm vs frozen Task.base_pose; rotation principal angle from normalized absolute quaternion dot product
metric_contracts.robot_target_clearance: Saved native target_minimum_m over original robot-target pair set; censor flags retained in CSV
metric_contracts.related_sphere_clearance: Sealed route_clearance.npz continuum_obstacle_minimum_m at all native states; distinct pair set; no new query
metric_contracts.route_window: Per-Task frozen complete closed interval, no endpoint or horizon search
metric_contracts.display_thinning: Native trajectory/safety display every tenth original state plus final; tracking plots all consumed ticks; statistics never thinned
metric_contracts.source_lifecycle: All consumed inputs checked against sealed payload/external SHA256 and rehashed unchanged at completion; local source locators are provenance; generated CSV/PDF/PNG are self-contained review artifacts
